findings.finding: approved_for_bounded_screen boolean is accepted without comparing the reviewed scientific/source hashes to current files before copying. Review can become stale as adapters are still edited.
findings.action: Require all bundled reviewed executable and scientific metadata hashes to match the independent review snapshot before copying/freezing; retain static dry-run and manifest hash after assembly.

findings.finding: CPU quotas include v1 fallback, but available-memory limit only reads cgroup-v2 memory.max/current. On v1,/proc/meminfo may describe host memory rather than task allowance.
findings.action: Implement v1 memory.limit_in_bytes/usage_in_bytes fallback or fail closed outside verified cgroup-v2 scope; remote admission receipt still required.
